contribution_decision: Continue physical long-return damping as primary and matched finite-duration band transfer as fallback. The former antipodal classical reference with no compensating angular connection has a half-turn LLL return and lacks the retained leading free-channel support. A monotone point-dipole delay bound gives the wrong averaged source sign in the retained asymptotic family. Reflection gluing removes that relative twist and makes the electric load odd; its specified classical matching requires nonzero rotation charge at fixed outer frames. These results correct an internal model choice; no general wormhole obstruction or consequential novelty is accepted. Physical state, angular transport, omitted response and smooth junction remain open.
